author: Praxis I
title: BRBG-Dual-AdaptPC: ComBat-PCA64 Soft-Whitened Embedding (alpha=0.7) + Equal-Quota Graph
abstract: Keep the EID 185 graph; modify only the embedding: scale PCA64 axes by var^{-alpha/2} with alpha=0.7 (soft whitening). Goal: retain most mixing gains from whitening while improving ASW_label and Cell_cycle vs full/near-full whitening.
